releaseNotes:
Official Release v1.3.21:
- Thermal Receipt Single Clean Cut: Eliminated redundant cut sequences and calibrated feed length to stop orphan blank paper strips between kitchen tickets and sales receipts.
- Masked Employee Passcodes: Sensitive staff PINs concealed by default with SVG eye toggle for authorized role-based visibility.
- Role-Restricted Manager PIN Security: Manager passcodes locked to matching manager identity or Admin master verification.
- Two-Tier PIN Audit Trail: Dedicated managerial inspection console and unrestricted master admin audit log with ESC/POS audit slip printing.
- Verified Integrity: 100% pre-flight automated validation passed across 71 modal dialogs.
